decisions.reason: The Magento 2 shop template sits close to the core agency hosting offer and costs little to maintain, and with turnover growing and the firm hiring, it has the slack to carry it even though evidence of uptake is modest.

The responsive website template was only mentioned on the website, so its results are uncertain, but it is cheap and close to the established offer, and a growing firm faces little pressure to search for alternative uses of these resources.

Premium support directly extends the firm's core promise of round-the-clock expert support for agencies and likely earns recurring revenue that meets aspirations, so management has no reason to drop it.
The version management tool has its own page and fits the strategy of tools that reduce recurring operational work, which signals satisfactory performance and continued investment.

The data processing contract tool is distant from the core offer, but it answers GDPR demand among hosting customers and has its own page, and current slack lets the firm carry it while its results remain uncertain.
